# V4.6.1 Glavenus 🔥

1. 在「文件 > 单独模式」里选完文件夹后不再闪退
2. 编辑器和预览里的代码换回 V4.5.0 的配色，不再整片发黄
3. 默认换行模式下，跨多行的数学公式在预览和导出里也能正常渲染
4. 侧栏 Logo 在中文界面显示用思源宋体排的「妙言」，其他语言显示 MiaoYan，小鸟和文字跟文件夹图标、名称对齐，中文的「全部笔记」缩成「全部」
5. 删除相关的菜单和提示统一叫「移到废纸篓」，繁体中文改用「垃圾桶」，提示里的引号、省略号和冒号统一成一种写法

---

1. Choosing a folder from File > Single Mode no longer crashes the app
2. Code in the editor and preview is back to V4.5.0's colours instead of a yellow cast
3. Multi-line math now renders in the preview and exports under the default line-break mode too
4. The sidebar logo reads 妙言 in Source Han Serif for Chinese and MiaoYan in other languages, the bird and name line up with the folder icons and names, and All Notes reads 全部 in Chinese
5. Delete actions say Move to Trash everywhere, Traditional Chinese calls it 垃圾桶, and messages use one style of quotes, ellipses and colons
